## RuntimeProbeSchema variable

Runtime-probe metadata persisted on a resource after running `macts probe`<!-- -->.

The sdef-declared identifier is preserved in `identifiers` for provenance; this section records which property \*actually\* works at runtime.

**Signature:**

```typescript
RuntimeProbeSchema: z.ZodObject<
  {
    runtimeIdentifier: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>
    status: z.ZodEnum<{
      error: 'error'
      probed: 'probed'
      'no-items': 'no-items'
      failed: 'failed'
    }>
    probedAt: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>
    note: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>
  },
  z.core.$strip
>
```
